capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-transaction legacy bungalow address enrichment
source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data report builder was run across all 77 priced, addressless Savills legacy appearances whose saved property class identifies a bungalow. Fifty-eight sold candidates were checked. Fourteen matches were retained only where exact hammer price, locality or postcode district, freehold tenure, compatible bungalow class and a single transaction completing within 60 days aligned. Six multi-candidate and 37 no-compatible-result candidates were left unchanged; one unique exact-price candidate without sufficient property-class corroboration was also left partial. Original Savills/PropertyAuctions evidence and every repeat auction appearance remain preserved.
